dzh: 能反复出场的小角色和常用物件。拿去换姿势、换颜色,拼成自己的场景。
den: Small characters and everyday objects to reuse. Change the pose or colour and build your own scene.

dzh: 一幅画讲一个比喻:谁在做什么。画面里不写字,字放在网页上叠上去。
den: One picture, one metaphor: who is doing what. No words inside the drawing; the page lays text on top.

dzh: 宽银幕、一个光源、镜头在动。同一支铅笔,换成讲故事的节奏。
den: Widescreen, one light source, a moving camera. The same pencil, paced like a film.

dzh: 方框、分层、连线。手绘让结构图不像规范文档,读者更愿意看下去。
den: Boxes, layers and wires. Drawn by hand, a structure diagram stops looking like a spec.

dzh: 判断、分支、回路。会动的那一笔沿着流程走,告诉读者现在走到哪。
den: Decisions, branches and loops. The moving mark walks the flow and shows where we are.

dzh: 左边是代码,右边是它在做的事。当前那一行和画面同步高亮。
den: Code on one side, what it does on the other. The current line and the picture move together.

dzh: 把公式和算法的每一步画出来:球往山下滚、数组一半一半地砍。
den: Each step of a formula or algorithm, drawn: a ball rolling downhill, an array cut in half.

dzh: 手绘坐标轴,真实数据。点和线是铅笔画的,数字照样要对。
den: Hand-drawn axes, real numbers. The dots are pencil; the values still have to be right.

dzh: 圈重点、画箭头、贴便签、深色终端卡:叠在插画或截图上用。
den: Circles, arrows, sticky notes and a dark terminal card, laid over a drawing or a screenshot.
